Her bust carries a large faceted jewel set on each breast, a cut ruby-red stone with bright mirror facets in a gold setting, its central table facet fully and opaquely covering her nipple and areola, with fine gold claws and bright light rays radiating outward over the curve of her bust. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries anodised titanium in iridescent blue, violet and gold bands, a metallic oxide shimmer. Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
